questions.question: Who manages legal holds that suspend retention clocks?
questions.answer_preview:
Based on 4 retrieved passage(s) from the knowledge base:

## Legal holds

Legal holds suspend normal retention clocks. Holds are managed by Legal in the hold register and must list affected systems and custodians. Purge from active stores after 30 days unless a legal hold applies
